source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of nucleophilic substitution (PDF 79-81).

blocks.text: Nucleophilic substitution mein do amal hote hain: leaving group nikalta (C-X bond toot'ta) aur nucleophile hamla karta (C-Nu bond banta). Agar dono aik hi qadam mein saath hon to mechanism SN2 hai. Agar do alag qadmon mein hon, pehle bond tootna phir bond banna, to mechanism SN1 hai.

SN2 aik qadmi mechanism hai. Jaise hi nucleophile electrophilic carbon par hamla shuru karta hai, leaving group wala bond tootna shuru ho jata hai; bond banna aur tootna saath saath chalte hain. Nucleophile leaving group ki mukhalif simt se hamla karta hai. Kyunke is aik (rate tay karne wale) qadam mein do molecules shamil hain, reaction bimolecular hai, aur is ki raftaar dono concentrations par munhasir hai: rate = k[halogenoalkane][nucleophile], is liye yeh second order (1 + 1 = 2) hai.

blocks.alt: Lone pair wala HO- bromomethane ke delta+ carbon par Br ki mukhalif simt se hamla karta, jab ke doosra curly teer C-Br ke electrons Br par le jata. Brackets mein transition state HO...C...Br, dono bonds dashed aur manfi charge; phir CH3OH + Br-. Neeche: rate = k[halogenoalkane][nucleophile], second order.
blocks.caption: SN2 mechanism (kitab ke khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Hydroxide ion carbon ke paas peeche se, bromine ki mukhalif simt se, aata hai. Transition state mein O-C bond aadha bana aur C-Br bond aadha toota hota hai, aur teen hydrogens hamwar hote hain. Phir bromide nikalta aur methanol banta hai; carbon ke baqi groups chhatri ki tarah ulat jate hain.

blocks.text: Primary halogenoalkanes nucleophiles ke hamle par SN2 se react karte hain. Is ki wajah steric hai: carbon par hydrogen atoms ya sirf aik alkyl group hota hai, is liye nucleophile aasani se us tak pohanch kar hamla kar sakta hai.

SN1 ke do qadam hain. Pehle halogenoalkane aabi acetone ya aabi ethanol jaise solvent mein ulat sakne wale tareeqe se ionise ho kar carbocation darmiyani halat deta hai. Doosre, nucleophile carbocation par hamla kar ke product deta hai. Pehla qadam covalent bond torta hai, is liye sust hai; doosra, mukhalif charge wale ions ka milna, tez hai. Sust pehla qadam rate tay karta aur is mein sirf aik molecule hai, is liye mechanism unimolecular hai: rate = k[halogenoalkane], first order.

blocks.alt: Qadam 1 (sust): (CH3)3C-Br ionise ho kar tertiary carbocation (CH3)3C+ aur Br- deta. Qadam 2 (tez): (CH3)3C+ + OH- se (CH3)3C-OH; rate = k[halogenoalkane], first order. Neeche: carbocation istehkaam, tertiary (CH3)3C+ > secondary (CH3)2CH+ > primary CH3CH2+ > methyl CH3+.
blocks.caption: SN1 mechanism aur carbocation ka istehkaam (kitab ke khaakon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Raftaar sirf is par munhasir hai ke halogenoalkane kitni tezi se ionise hota hai, is liye yeh nucleophile ke concentration par munhasir nahi. Carbocation alkyl groups se mustahkam hota hai, jo musbat carbon ki taraf electron density dhakelte hain (+I inductive effect); jitne zyada alkyl groups, carbocation utna mustahkam aur utni aasani se banta hai.

blocks.text: Tertiary halogenoalkanes nucleophiles ke hamle par SN1 se react karte hain. Asal wajah yeh hai ke yeh mustahkam tertiary carbocation banate hain; saath hi electrophilic carbon par teen bhari groups nucleophile ko leaving group ke peeche se hamla karne se rokte hain. Secondary halogenoalkane solvent ke mutabiq SN2 ya SN1 kisi se bhi react kar sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Tertiary halogenoalkanes SN1 se aur primary SN2 se kyun react karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Tertiary: teen alkyl groups carbocation ko mustahkam karte aur peeche se hamla rokte. Primary: carbocation na-mustahkam hota, lekin carbon par bheer nahi, is liye nucleophile aik qadam mein seedha hamla kar sakta.

items: SN2: aik qadam, peeche se hamla, rate = k[RX][Nu], primary halogenoalkanes.
SN1: sust ionisation se carbocation, phir tez hamla; rate = k[RX], tertiary halogenoalkanes.
Carbocation istehkaam: tertiary > secondary > primary > methyl.
